svg.title: Prescribed geometry is not learned geometry
svg.desc: Analytic reference: a downward paraboloid has positive Gaussian curvature, a saddle has variable negative curvature, and the Poincare disk metric has constant curvature minus one. No checkpoint data is used.

g.text: Prescribed geometry is not learned geometry
Analytic reference only - no checkpoint data
Hypercomplex algebra additionally needs a specified product and verified laws; a picture does not supply them.
